agent-readiness.title: AEO
agent-readiness.subtitle: How your site shows up to AI answer engines
agent-readiness.setup.heading: Get started with AEO
agent-readiness.setup.description: Confirm the market we measure you against — we already know your domain, so this only takes a moment.
agent-readiness.setup.stepMarketHint: We probe answer engines with real questions people ask in this category.
agent-readiness.setup.stepStoryHint: In your own words, what do you do? This helps us read the results the way your customers would describe you.
agent-readiness.setup.storyPlaceholder: Tell us about what you think you do…
agent-readiness.setup.stepCompetitorsHin: These are the brands we score Share of Voice against. Your domain is added automatically.
agent-readiness.setup.competitorsAuto: We’ll score you against the leading brands in %{topic}.
agent-readiness.setup.competitorsPending: Pick a category to see who we score you against.
agent-readiness.setup.stepTrackHint: Panels run on a shared schedule across these agents, so results are ready fast.
agent-readiness.setup.promptsNote: Next, you'll see the industry questions we already ask — then add your own before we start.
agent-readiness.setup.detecting: Analyzing your site to pre-fill these…
agent-readiness.setup.detected: Pre-filled from your site — adjust anything that looks off.
agent-readiness.industryPrompts.heading: Questions we already ask for your industry
agent-readiness.industryPrompts.descript: Every site in %{topic} is measured against this shared set of questions — it’s how we rank Share of Model across your category. They run automatically on a shared schedule; you don’t manage them. You’ll add your own questions next.
agent-readiness.industryPrompts.changeHi: Not your market? Go back to change it.
agent-readiness.industryPrompts.loadErro: We couldn’t load the industry questions right now, but they’ll still run for your category. Continue to add your own questions.
agent-readiness.prompts.heading: Add your own questions
agent-readiness.prompts.description: On top of the industry questions, we drafted these from your site and category. Edit, remove, or add your own — up to 10. These run for your site specifically, alongside the shared industry set.
agent-readiness.prompts.synthError: We couldn't draft questions automatically. Add your own below to continue.
agent-readiness.prompts.startError: We couldn't start tracking for this market. Please try again in a moment.
agent-readiness.pending.body: Answer engines are being probed across your category. Share of Voice appears as soon as the panel completes — usually within a few minutes.
agent-readiness.panelStarting.heading: Setting up your citation panel
agent-readiness.panelStarting.benchmarkB: Your scan is complete. We’re now running the industry benchmark to rank you against competitors — this usually takes a few minutes. Your results appear here automatically.
agent-readiness.panelStarting.refreshing: Your new scan is running. Updated citation metrics replace the previous run here automatically once it finishes — usually within a few minutes.
agent-readiness.hero.visibilityTip: The share of answers in this category that cite your site as a source when people ask.
agent-readiness.hero.prominenceTip: When you are cited, how prominently you appear — how much of the cited content is yours and how early it lands. A quality score, not a share of your citations.
agent-readiness.hero.mentionsTip: How often answer engines name your brand in this category — whether or not they cite you.
agent-readiness.hero.referralsTip: Real visits that answer engines sent to your site in the latest daily window.
agent-readiness.citation.heading: Your citations
agent-readiness.citation.description: How answer engines cite your site when they answer questions in this category — measured first-party, on your own domain.
agent-readiness.citation.gap: Answer engines mention you in %{mentions} of answers but only cite you in %{visibility} — a chance to earn the citation, not just the mention.
agent-readiness.citation.pending: We are probing answer engines with real questions from your category. Your citation metrics appear here as soon as the panel completes — usually within a few minutes.
agent-readiness.citation.running: We're probing answer engines with your questions right now. This usually takes a few minutes — feel free to leave this page and come back. Your citation metrics appear here automatically once the panel finishes.
agent-readiness.assistants.heading: By AI assistant
agent-readiness.assistants.description: For each assistant: how many of its answers named you, how many cited you as a source, and how prominently you appeared when cited.
agent-readiness.assistants.prominenceHin: A 0–100 depth score for the answers that cite you — higher means more of the cited content is yours and it lands earlier. This is a citation-quality measure, not a share of your citations.
agent-readiness.answerEngineActivity.sub: Per operator: how much it crawls your content, whether it refers visitors back, and the errors it hits
agent-readiness.answerEngineActivity.gap: No AI crawler or referral activity for this zone yet. Operators appear here once they start fetching or citing your content.
agent-readiness.answerEngineActivity.cra: Blocked (403) and dead-link (404) responses returned to this operator when it crawled your content
agent-readiness.answerEngineActivity.ref: Blocked (403) and dead-link (404) responses on links this operator referred visitors to
agent-readiness.answerEngineActivity.int: Crawls show which AI operators read your content and referrals which send you visitors — operators that crawl but never refer are ingesting your content without citing you back (the reciprocity gap to close). Errors count the 403 (blocked) + 404 (dead link) responses you returned them.
agent-readiness.som.heading: Share of Voice
agent-readiness.som.description: Your share of AI citations versus the competitive set, across the models we probe.
agent-readiness.industryFit.title: Industry fit
agent-readiness.industryFit.subtitle: Whether your content reads like the market you’re measured against
agent-readiness.industryFit.pending: We’ll assess your industry fit once your citation panel has gathered enough answers.
agent-readiness.industryFit.aligned: Your content matches your configured market.
agent-readiness.industryFit.misaligned: Your content looks more like %{suggested} than %{current}. If that’s a better fit, consider changing your market.
